patterns.note: Minimalist layout characterized by generous whitespace, full-width content blocks, and a strong focus on large-scale typography as primary visual elements.
Dominant display headings feature a highly stylized, thin-lined, geometric outline font, often presented in a layered, slightly offset arrangement for a dynamic static effect.
A stark monochromatic palette of black and white is used for all structural and textual elements, with a single warm, reddish-orange accent derived from the hero video content.

A minimalist header containing the site logo and navigation remains sticky at the top of the viewport, while the rest of the page content scrolls vertically beneath it without complex reveals or parallax effects.

Sections are defined by large vertical breaks and distinct content types (hero video, large text block, subscription form), rather than by alternating background colors or complex structural variations.

technique_notes: A full-width video hero section plays automatically, serving as a dynamic background for overlaid text and calls to action.

Large, impactful display text is rendered by layering multiple instances of the same text with subtle horizontal and vertical offsets, creating a visually rich, almost three-dimensional static effect.
The site employs a standard vertical scroll, with a minimalist sticky header that maintains brand presence without transforming or shrinking, ensuring a consistent top-level navigation experience.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, decorative display headings (~5-10x body text) with a thin, outlined character, contrasted by small, understated sans-serif body text and labels.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy, with significant vertical padding between sections and ample negative space around key elements, creating a grand and open feel.

standout: The most distinctive feature is the highly stylized, layered outline typography used for major headings, which creates a powerful visual identity that is both artistic and memorable, elevating simple text into a key design element.
